blocks.content: Indian Railways is the fourth-largest national railway system in the world by size.

rows: Secondary lines (largely converted under Project Unigauge)

items: frequently tested: Match the Railway Zone with its correct Headquarters (e.g., South Central - Secunderabad, East Coast - Bhubaneswar).
Direct questions often ask for the length/width of Broad Gauge (1.676 m) vs Metre Gauge (1.000 m).
World's longest railway platform location (Hubballi, Karnataka) is a high-yield static GK question.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India ran on April 16, 1853, between Mumbai (Bori Bunder) and Thane covering 34 km.
Indian Railways was nationalized in the year 1951 and is now divided into 19 administrative zones.
Computerized passenger reservation system was first introduced in New Delhi in 1986.
The National Rail Museum is situated at Chanakyapuri, New Delhi.
